import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
cameras = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Set the style for the plot
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a scatter plot to visualize the relationship between price and megapixels, colored by sensor type
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
scatter_plot = sns.scatterplot(
    data=cameras,
    x='megapixels',
    y='price_usd',
    hue='sensor_type',
    palette='deep',
    alpha=0.7
)

# Set plot title and labels
scatter_plot.set_title('Price vs. Megapixels by Sensor Type', fontsize=16)
scatter_plot.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=12)
scatter_plot.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=12)

# Add legend with a title
scatter_plot.legend(title='Sensor Type')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

)
